Slow Roll Cleveland

Cleveland, OH · Social

No-dropBeginner friendlyFamily

Slow Roll Cleveland is a social group ride in Cleveland, OH. It rolls every Monday at 7:00 pm. About 10 miles, leisurely, all ages and abilities. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: leisurely, all ages and abilities. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @slowrollcleve the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow Roll Cleveland group ride

About ten miles at an easy pace through a different Cleveland neighborhood every Monday. Hundreds of riders of all backgrounds and abilities. Check the schedule for that week's meeting spot.
